responsibilities.name: Weekly Executive Update
responsibilities.instruction: Produce this week's Weekly Executive Update to structure the 30-minute weekly executive sync. Recall the weekly-executive-update process playbook, gather the most recent notes for each of this deployment's designated weekly source meetings, and synthesize a time-boxed executive briefing: an agenda-at-a-glance, a short State of the Week, per-area status with blockers flagged inline, the decisions to lock this week, and an owner/action/due table. Deliver it as a branded document in the exec-summaries folder and report the link.
responsibilities.success_criteria: The Weekly Executive Update for this week has been produced as a branded Google Doc in the exec-summaries folder and its shareable link reported. The agent READ THE FINISHED DOCUMENT BACK to confirm it contains the required sections (agenda-at-a-glance, State of the Week, per-area status with blockers, Decisions to Lock, and an owner/action/due Action Items table), is sourced only from the four designated weekly meetings, and has names/acronyms normalized (e.g. SOC 2). If a document for this week already existed, it was updated rather than duplicated. The read-back content is the evidence — a claim of creation without reading it back does not satisfy this.

context.purpose: Leadership runs a 30-minute weekly executive sync and needs one reliable, skimmable briefing, built the same way every week from that week's meeting notes.
process: RECALL: load the 'Weekly Executive Update' process playbook and this deployment's FOUR designated source meetings, the exec-summaries folder id, and the brand-guide doc id from project context / memory.

GATHER (from Drive, not the calendar): for each of the four designated meetings, read only the MOST RECENT occurrence's notes/transcript from the shared meeting-notes Drive folder — list it, pick the latest by date, never older weeks, and exclude any non-designated meeting (e.g. Weekly Strategy).

SYNTHESIZE at executive altitude: distill into the fixed 30-minute scaffold — agenda-at-a-glance, State of the Week, per-area status with inline blocker flags, Decisions to Lock, and an owner/action/due Action Items table capped at the ~5-10 top actions. Normalize names/acronyms (e.g. SOC 2). One definitive briefing, not several drafts.

DELIVER in one pass: create (or, if this week's doc already exists, update) the branded Google Doc in the exec-summaries folder with docs-create-branded --brand-doc <brand id> — content and branding in the SAME step.

VERIFY with evidence: read the finished doc back to confirm every required section is present and the sources/branding are right, then report its shareable link. The read-back is the proof — do not report done without it.
